measurement_description: The paper does not analyze aspects of religion. Its benchmark, MM-SCALE, measures scalar moral judgments (acceptability on a 1-5 scale) for multimodal scenarios concerning general socionormative situations, safety, and ethics, but does not include any scenarios specifically related to religion or faith.
